Windows B Engram coding lane. Rev 2 by Engram::Fable, 2026-11-27: rev 1's slot and FULL lines were stale, and winb-engram-lane-procedure (rev 5 or later) governs every WinB Engram coder.
Native session-13 (Engram::Codex-WinB-Coder) runs Codex gpt-6.2-sol at high reasoning effort. Its workdir is C:\GitHub\Personal\Engram-runner. The WinB-local Engram store exchanges task and memory text through engram-data. Claims stay local to Windows B, so this lane takes only items named by Engram::Fable or Engram::Fable-WinB (WinB session-27).
For every cargo job, send START to Fable-WinB, wait for its named grant, then send END. This follows the WinB cargo budget, TermAl memory winb-cargo-budget-2026-11-26.
Strict Clippy and FULL run on WinB in the granted slot. A WinB FULL counts with equal weight. If a FULL stops only at Clippy, Greg's #1396 practice applies: run the remaining stages as focused legs on the same commit.
